claims.text: VZV: acyclovir 10 to 15 mg/kg IV every 8 h for 10 to 14 days, ± adjunctive corticosteroids if immunocompetent.
claims.quote: Acyclovir 10 to 15 mg/kg IV every 8 hours for 10 to 14 days, with possible adjunctive corticosteroids in immunocompetent patients, is recommended for varicella-zoster virus.
